To determine the quarter of a given month (1-12), we can use integer division. By adding 2 to the month and then dividing by 3 (ignoring the remainder), we correctly group months 1-3 into quarter 1, months 4-6 into quarter 2, and so on.

Confidence level: 100%

```python
def quarter(month):
    return (month + 2) // 3
```
